title: Close CORE-09 verifier residuals V1 and V2

changes.V1: _TASK_KEYS is now {task, task_id, observation_type, reference_side}. A reviewed or approved profile whose applicability block uses only these keys is refused, in any combination, the same way task-only blocks are. The message keeps 'more than the task' and adds 'or observation structure'. Blocks that add a population or condition key (e.g. population plus reference_side) still release.
changes.V2: Chose to refuse rather than serialize. Before any read, build_release json.dumps the profile review (allow_nan=False) for every supplied profile, labelled or legacy, because both copy it into quality.json and manifest.json. A non-JSON value such as an unquoted YAML date raises a ReleaseError asking for dates to be quoted. The existing rule that reviewed_at must be quoted is unchanged; it still fails first, with 'quote timestamps'.
changes.V1_identity: At the coordinator's request, _TASK_KEYS is now {task, task_id, observation_type} plus IDENTITY_COLUMNS (subject, source_recording_id, observation_id, reference_side). A block made only of identity keys is refused like a task-only block. New test: test_identity_only_applicability_is_refused (4 cases). Run against a scratchpad copy with the previous key set (no repository edits), all 4 failed; they pass now.

committed_profiles: No committed range profile declares review_status or a top-level review, so neither change newly refuses any of them.
changed_files: contributor_tools/DATA_CONTRACT.md (only the release-section refusal sentence; now names the identity columns)
tests/test_release_builder_gaps.py (new CORE-10 tests: structural-key combinations, population plus structure, unquoted date for reviewed and legacy profiles, reviewed_at still needs quotes)
tests/test_release_builder_gaps_verify.py (verifier file: only the V1 and V2 strict-xfail decorator lines removed)

failing_then_passing.after: 3 XPASS(strict) after the fixes; markers removed; 3 passed. Assertions unchanged.

failing_then_passing.before: The new tests were run against a scratchpad copy of the pre-CORE-10 builder, loaded by a pytest plugin with no repository edits. 4 failed for the expected reasons: two structural combinations were not refused, and two cases raised 'TypeError: Object of type date is not JSON serializable'. The other 41 tests in the file passed.
